# CktHub

> CktHub builds standalone ESP32 and ESP32-S3 hardware that does the work of
> subscription-based software tools locally. Pay once, own the device. No
> monthly bill, no cloud dependency. Designed and assembled in-house in Pune,
> India by Ambivert Technologies Private Limited.

## What CktHub does

- Replaces recurring SaaS subscriptions (POS, kiosks, signage, attendance,
  access control, visitor management, inventory tracking, data logging) with
  dedicated hardware you buy once and own.
- Every product starts as a PCB, 3D print, laser, or CNC part made in the
  CktHub Fab lab in Pune.

## Key facts

- Products: ready-to-use dev boards (ESP32 / ESP32-S3 based) and made-to-order
  hardware built around your workflow.
- Pricing: boards at a fixed one-time price (e.g. CKT-WROVER-DEVKIT and
  CKT-S3-DEVKIT); fab work quoted instantly with no file required, confirmed
  on WhatsApp.
- Fab services: PCB fabrication (2-6 layer), 3D printing (PETG; PLA/ABS/RESIN
  quoted on request), laser marking and cutting, CNC/VMC machining
  (aluminium, acrylic, brass).
- Contact: WhatsApp +91-99601-60016, email hello@ambiverttech.com,
  Excellaa Plazzo A107, Ambegaon Budruk, Pune 411046, India.

## Quote engine (for agent use)

The fab page computes estimates client-side with a transparent rule set:
PCB = overseas reference price (USD min per layer count, $1 = ~84 INR) +
shipping (2000-3000 INR) + 3x markup; 3D print = setup 50 INR + per-gram
material rate x estimated weight; laser = setup 40 INR + 0.8 INR/cm2 mark or
2.5 INR/cm2 cut + 10 INR/piece; CNC = setup 300 INR + per-cm3 material rate
+ 50 INR/piece. Materials or modes without a rate display "contact us" and
are quoted manually on WhatsApp.
